system.description:
Once per turn as a Swift Action, you can spend a Force Point to let one adjacent ally use the Aid Another Action (as a Reaction) to assist you with a Skill Check. You must make the Skill Check before the end of your turn, or the benefit of the Aid Another Action is lost.

An ally that has already used the Aid Another Action to assist you since the end of your last turn may not be targeted by this Talent.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
